agent_native_search_guardrail.evidence: Agent-native baseline artifacts are parsed from local JSON and must include hashed task logs plus source transcripts or native-search exports, the checked agent-native measurement protocol, and a passing measured preflight artifact with matching source hashes before metric thresholds can pass.
agent_native_search_guardrail.next_baseline: Run `callsieve agent-native-protocol --out benchmarks/public/results/agent-native-protocol.json`, generate a template with `callsieve agent-native-template`, fill agent_native_files and transcript-backed agent_native_context_tokens from an approved native-search run, save the preflight with `callsieve agent-native-check --mode measured --out benchmarks/public/results/<tool>-check.json`, convert it with `callsieve agent-native-baseline`, then add the check under terminal_artifacts and the baseline under agent_native_search_baselines.
